data.comment:
# Comfy Wan2.7- Image to Video

Upload an image and audio file to generate a video with synchronized sound, using the first and last frames for control. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_wan2_7_i2v.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.

data.model.prompt: Starting from the front view, the camera slowly orbits behind the TV-headed figure, settling over its shoulder and looking out across the dim, blurred office into the darkness beyond. A deep ambient bass tone hums. The figure doesn't move, but the screen's glow casts a faint rectangle of light forward into the dark room. TV Head (quietly): "Something's out there." The screen flickers once. "It's been watching us back."
